openapi_spec: {"openapi": "3.0.0", "info": {"title": "Loan Application API", "version": "1.0.0"}, "paths": {"/applications": {"post": {"summary": "Submit a loan application", "requestBody": {"required": true, "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"type": "object", "required": ["applicant_name", "annual_income", "loan_amount"], "properties": {"applicant_name": {"type": "string"}, "annual_income": {"type": "number"}, "loan_amount": {"type": "number"}}}}}}, "responses": {"201": {"description": "Application accepted"}, "400": {"description": "Invalid input"}, "401": {"description": "Unauthorized"}, "422": {"description": "Application declined"}}}}}}
documentation: The Loan Application API accepts new loan applications for underwriting. An application is automatically declined with a 422 response if annual_income is below 20000, or if loan_amount exceeds 5 times annual_income. Otherwise the application is accepted with a 201 response and queued for manual review. All requests require a valid bearer token issued to the calling team.
